This is a senior-level backend/database engineering role at Grafana Labs, remote in Canada or the US, on a new team building the storage layer for an AI-native data intelligence platform that gives AI agents governed access to enterprise context. The work covers ingestion, query planning, distributed query execution, and data/storage formats for a multi-tenant database with both OLAP and transactional capabilities, plus the APIs that agents, MCP tools, and CLIs use to retrieve data. The core stack is Go, C++, or Rust, with distributed systems, query engines, catalogs and table formats, cloud-native deployment across multiple providers, and observability instrumentation.
